fileDescription: Service templates for desktop and laptop computer work.
Use sharedWorkflow with the selected component service. Record the result of each step, not just whether it was checked.
Only show service types present on a component. Update and maintenance are additional service types that the application must support.

rules: When a primary fault is found, assess what else it may have damaged before quoting. Record each part as confirmed damaged, tested good, or not yet tested.
Record recommended next steps with a quoted scope (labor and parts) as part of the diagnostic outcome.
A completed step must describe what was actually done or observed.
A skipped or blocked step must include a reason.
Record actual readings and test durations when available. Do not invent them.
Record the original and replacement part details when a part is changed.
Do not mark a service complete until its final verification has been performed or documented as blocked.

intake.title: Record the customer's symptoms and when they occur
Record the device model, identifying details, and visible damage
Confirm the approved work, data handling, and backup instructions

beforeOpening.title: Shut down and disconnect external power
Follow model-specific battery and electrical safety instructions
Photograph cable placement or damage when it will help reassembly

closeout.title: Record recommended next steps with a quoted scope of labor and parts
Record parts installed, settings changed, and tests performed
Record remaining issues and any tests that could not be performed
Write a plain-language customer summary of the result

diagnostic.description: We’ll find out whether the power supply or its connections are causing power problems.

steps.title: Record what happens when the power button is pressed
Check the outlet, external power cable, and power switch
Inspect external power connections for damage or looseness
Check internal power connections with power disconnected
Test with an approved tester or known-good compatible power supply
Record the test method, result, and most likely cause
If the supply failed, assess motherboard, RAM, CPU, GPU, and drives for collateral damage
Quote the repair scope: added labor plus parts for each damaged component

repair.description: We’ll correct power connections or replace a failed power supply.

steps.title: Disconnect wall power and confirm the replacement is compatible
Replace damaged external or internal power cables
Replace the power supply if testing shows it has failed
Use only modular cables approved for that exact power supply
Check startup, shutdown, and operation under normal use

upgrade.description: We’ll install a compatible power supply for the system’s planned hardware.

steps.title: Confirm wattage, connectors, case fit, and power requirements
Remove the old supply and all of its modular cables
Install the new supply with its approved cables
Check all connections before applying power
Record the model and test startup and normal use

diagnostic.description: We’ll narrow down startup, connection, and motherboard faults.

steps.title: Inspect for corrosion, burnt areas, and bent, missing, or pushed-in CPU socket pins
If socket pins are damaged, stop and follow the physical damage path
Record startup lights, display behavior, and beep codes
Check power, RAM, graphics, and front-panel connections
Test with only essential parts connected when appropriate
For severe or unknown-cause failures, use the out-of-case test
Record which parts and connections were ruled out

repair.description: We’ll correct serviceable connection faults or replace a failed motherboard.

steps.title: Confirm the fault and the approved repair
Reseat or replace damaged removable connections as needed
Replace a failed CMOS battery if indicated
Replace the motherboard if repairable parts are not the cause
Check startup, ports, storage, and system stability

upgrade.description: We’ll install a motherboard that supports the approved hardware and features.

steps.title: Confirm CPU, RAM, cooler, case, storage, and power compatibility
Confirm backup instructions and verify the recovery key if encrypted
Install the new board and reconnect components
Check firmware settings, boot, and required drivers
Record activation status and test ports and network access

diagnostic.description: We’ll check whether memory or its settings are causing crashes or startup failures.

steps.title: Record installed memory and whether BIOS detects it
Check seating and the motherboard-recommended slots
Test individual sticks and slots when needed
Try safe memory settings if the system is unstable
Run a memory test and record passes, errors, and duration

repair.description: We’ll correct memory installation or settings and replace failed RAM.

steps.title: Reseat RAM with the computer disconnected from power
Restore stable memory settings if needed
Replace confirmed failed RAM with compatible memory
Check detected capacity and rerun the memory test

upgrade.description: We’ll install compatible memory to increase available RAM.

steps.title: Confirm memory type, capacity limits, and supported slots
Install a compatible kit in the recommended slots
Confirm the detected capacity
Enable XMP or EXPO only if supported and stable
Record the final speed and memory-test result

diagnostic.description: We’ll check processor detection, temperature, and stability.

steps.title: Record the CPU model and firmware-reported settings
Inspect the socket and CPU for visible damage if removal is needed
Check cooler operation and idle temperature
Review crashes or shutdowns reported under load
Run a monitored test only while temperatures remain safe
Record temperatures, test duration, and errors

repair.description: We’ll address serviceable CPU installation or cooling problems.

steps.title: Confirm whether the fault is cooling, installation, or compatibility
Inspect the socket and CPU for visible damage if removal is needed
Correct the installation or cooler mounting
Apply fresh thermal interface material if the cooler was removed
Record idle and monitored load temperatures after repair

upgrade.description: We’ll install a compatible processor and verify cooling and stability.

steps.title: Confirm socket, firmware, cooling, and power compatibility
Update firmware first only if required and separately approved
Install the CPU and cooler with fresh thermal interface material
Check detection, temperatures, and a monitored stability test

diagnostic.description: We’ll check display connections, graphics hardware, drivers, and stability.

steps.title: Check monitor input, cables, and graphics card output
Check card seating and required power connections
Check driver errors and test another output when available
Run a monitored graphics test if the system is stable enough
Record artifacts, temperature, errors, and test duration

repair.description: We’ll correct serviceable graphics card connections, cooling, or driver issues.

steps.title: Reseat the card and check its power connections
Clean accessible dust and replace a serviceable failed fan if needed
Reinstall the graphics driver if a software fault is indicated
Recommend card replacement or specialist repair for board faults
Record display output and monitored test results

upgrade.description: We’ll install a compatible graphics card and test it.

steps.title: Confirm case clearance, power capacity, connectors, and PCIe slot
Install the card and connect its required power cables
Install the appropriate driver
Check each required display and run a monitored graphics test

diagnostic.description: We’ll check drive detection, health, and access to files.

steps.title: Record the drive model, capacity, and reported symptoms
Check detection and connections
Review SMART or manufacturer health information
Avoid extended scans if failure signs put data at risk
Record health results and the backup or recovery recommendation

repair.description: We’ll correct storage connections, approved boot problems, or a failed drive.

steps.title: Confirm backup instructions before making changes
Reseat the drive or replace a faulty removable cable
Repair boot files only with approval
Replace a failed drive and restore approved data if available
Record boot and file-access results

upgrade.description: We’ll install a compatible drive with the approved data-migration plan.

steps.title: Confirm drive form factor, interface, and capacity support
Confirm backup, cloning, or reinstall instructions
Install the new drive and complete the approved migration
Check boot order, capacity, health, and file access

diagnostic.description: We’ll identify Windows startup, driver, update, or software problems.

steps.title: Record symptoms and recent changes
Check startup, Device Manager, and relevant error records
Check storage health before extensive repair attempts
Use recovery media when needed without changing data
Record the likely cause and recommended next step

repair.description: We’ll perform approved repairs to Windows and its drivers.

steps.title: Confirm backup instructions and recovery-key access
Repair startup or system files as indicated
Remove or correct the identified software or driver fault
Install approved updates and required drivers
Record startup, device, activation, and normal-use results

upgrade.description: We’ll move to an approved, supported Windows installation.

steps.title: Confirm device support, license, backup, and customer approval
Verify recovery-key access before changing encrypted storage
Perform the approved upgrade or reinstall
Install required drivers, updates, and approved software
Record activation, file access, startup, and device tests

repair.description: We’ll reinstall or reimage Windows when repair is not practical.

steps.title: Confirm customer approval, license, and that data loss is understood
Back up or clone the drive (for example with Clonezilla) and verify the image
Verify recovery-key access before changing encrypted storage
Choose and record the method: reset, clean reinstall, or restore image
Install drivers, updates, and approved software
Restore approved data and record activation, startup, and device results

maintenance.description: We’ll tune Windows settings such as the page file and startup load.

steps.title: Record installed RAM, free disk space, and memory-related symptoms
Check page file (virtual memory) size and location; restore system-managed sizing if altered
Review startup programs, pending updates, and disk cleanup needs
Record settings changed and before-and-after behavior

diagnostic.description: We’ll assess liquid or contamination damage and which components may survive.

steps.title: Record the liquid type, when it happened, and what was done since
Keep the system unpowered and disconnect external power
Check for residue, corrosion, and affected areas
Inspect each component for contamination and corrosion
Annotate what is cleanable, needs replacement, or if the system is unrecoverable

repair.description: We’ll clean contaminated components one by one and replace those that cannot be saved.

steps.title: Confirm approved scope and that success is not guaranteed
Remove components and clean each with appropriate solution, then dry fully
Replace components that are corroded or fail testing
Reassemble and test each component, then the whole system
Record parts cleaned, replaced, and remaining risk of delayed corrosion

diagnostic.description: After a primary fault, we’ll check what else it damaged.

steps.title: Record the primary fault and how it was confirmed
Test every other component using known-good parts or a bench setup
Record each component as damaged, good, or untested
Quote the full scope and explain the effect on cost to the customer

diagnostic.description: We’ll assess bent pins, broken parts, and other physical damage.

steps.title: Annotate the damage, including bent or missing socket pins
Record whether the damaged part is repairable or must be replaced
Check whether the cause damaged other parts
Quote the revised scope and risks before continuing

repair.description: We’ll repair or replace physically damaged parts with customer approval.

steps.title: Confirm approval and the risk of further damage
Attempt pin straightening only when approved; otherwise replace the part
Record the original and replacement part details
Test startup and the affected components

diagnostic.description: We’ll test essential parts outside the case to isolate severe or unknown failures.

steps.title: Set up on a safe, nonconductive surface with known-good power
Connect only one part from customer PC at a time, use all other known good test parts
Record startup result, then add one part at a time
Record which part or connection causes failure

diagnostic.description: We’ll check the CPU cooler, its fan or pump, and temperature behavior.

steps.title: Record idle temperature and fan or pump readings
Inspect cooler mounting, connections, dust, and unusual noise
Check temperature under a monitored load if safe
Record temperatures, throttling, and the suspected cooling fault

repair.description: We’ll correct a failing CPU cooler or its connections.

steps.title: Clean accessible cooler dust and check fan or pump connections
Replace a failed serviceable fan or cooler
Apply fresh thermal interface material if the cooler was removed
Record fan behavior and idle and monitored load temperatures

upgrade.description: We’ll install a compatible cooler for the desired cooling or noise level.

steps.title: Confirm socket, case, RAM, and radiator clearance
Install the cooler and connect its fans or pump correctly
Set an appropriate fan profile
Record noise behavior and monitored temperatures

diagnostic.description: We’ll check case fan operation, noise, and airflow.

steps.title: Record which fans spin and any unusual sounds
Check fan direction, cables, hubs, and control settings
Check case airflow and relevant system temperatures
Record the faulty fan or airflow issue

repair.description: We’ll replace a failed case fan or correct its connection.

steps.title: Confirm fan size, connector, and airflow direction
Correct connections or install the replacement fan
Keep cables clear of moving blades
Record fan speed, noise, and airflow after repair

upgrade.description: We’ll add compatible fans to improve airflow or reduce noise.

steps.title: Plan intake and exhaust locations
Confirm sizes, headers, hub capacity, and power requirements
Install fans and route cables safely
Set fan controls and record temperature and noise results

diagnostic.description: We’ll check startup firmware settings and whether an update is actually needed.

steps.title: Record motherboard model and current firmware version
Check the reported symptom or hardware compatibility need
Review boot mode, drive detection, and relevant settings
Record whether a firmware update is recommended and why

update.description: We’ll install approved firmware for a specific compatibility, stability, or security need.

steps.title: Confirm the exact board model and approved firmware file
Record the current version and settings that must be restored
Verify backup instructions and recovery-key access if encrypted
Ensure stable power and follow the board maker's update method
Do not interrupt the update; follow the maker's recovery guidance if it fails
Confirm the new version, boot settings, and connected hardware
Record startup and encryption-recovery results

diagnostic.description: We’ll find out why the desktop runs hot, slows down, or shuts off.

steps.title: Record when heat, noise, or shutdowns occur
Check temperatures, clock behavior, and fan operation at idle
Inspect filters, vents, dust, and intake and exhaust paths
Run a monitored load test only if temperatures remain safe
Record readings, test duration, and likely heat source

maintenance.description: We’ll clean accessible airflow paths and adjust cooling settings.

steps.title: Disconnect power and protect fans while cleaning
Clean accessible filters, vents, fans, and heat sinks
Check cable placement and safe fan settings
Stop and recommend a repair if a fan or pump has failed
Record before-and-after temperatures under comparable conditions

diagnostic.description: We’ll check the affected desktop ports, wired network, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth.

steps.title: Record exactly which connection fails
Test with a known-good cable or device
Inspect the port and check Device Manager and settings
Record the tested ports and results

repair.description: We’ll correct serviceable connections, drivers, or removable port hardware.

steps.title: Confirm whether the cause is a port, cable, driver, or network
Correct the driver or replace a serviceable damaged part
Document any fault requiring motherboard repair
Retest the affected connections and record results

upgrade.description: We’ll install compatible networking or port expansion hardware.

steps.title: Confirm available slots, ports, drivers, and network requirements
Install the approved adapter and driver
Test the new ports or network connection
Record device detection and connection results

diagnostic.description: We’ll check the charger, charging port, and laptop power behavior.

steps.title: Record charging and startup symptoms
Check the charger rating, cable, and connector
Inspect the charging port for looseness or damage
Test a known-good compatible charger when available
Record charging and startup results

repair.description: We’ll replace a faulty charger or serviceable charging part.

steps.title: Confirm the failed part and replacement compatibility
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work
Replace the charger, removable port, cable, or charging board as indicated
Document a mainboard-level charging fault if present
Record charging and startup tests

diagnostic.description: We’ll check battery condition, charging, and runtime.

steps.title: Check for swelling or case separation before charging or testing
Stop use and follow battery safety procedures if swelling is found
Record reported capacity, health, and cycle count if available
Check charging and unplugged behavior only when safe
Record findings and whether replacement is recommended

repair.description: We’ll replace a failed battery when it can be handled safely.

steps.title: Confirm battery compatibility and safe handling requirements
Do not puncture or compress a swollen battery
Disconnect power and remove the battery using the model's procedure
Install the compatible replacement
Record battery detection, charging, and startup results
Arrange proper disposal of the old battery

diagnostic.description: We’ll narrow down laptop startup, charging, and internal connection faults.

steps.title: Record power lights, charging lights, and startup behavior
Inspect for liquid damage, corrosion, or burnt components
Check serviceable cables and small attached boards
Test removable parts when appropriate
Record what was ruled out and whether specialist work is needed

repair.description: We’ll correct serviceable connections or replace a failed removable board.

steps.title: Confirm backup instructions and the approved work
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work
Reseat affected cables or replace a failed removable board
Refer mainboard-level faults for approved specialist repair or replacement
Record startup and affected-device test results

diagnostic.description: We’ll check laptop memory and identify whether it is removable.

steps.title: Record detected memory and whether any is soldered
Check removable memory seating when applicable
Test individual removable modules when possible
Record memory-test passes, errors, and duration

repair.description: We’ll reseat or replace failed removable memory.

steps.title: Confirm the memory is removable and the replacement is compatible
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work
Reseat or replace the failed module
Document soldered-memory faults as a mainboard issue
Record detected capacity and memory-test results

upgrade.description: We’ll add memory only if the laptop supports it.

steps.title: Confirm upgradeable slots, supported type, and capacity
Disconnect the internal battery before installation
Install compatible memory
Record detected capacity and memory-test results

diagnostic.description: We’ll check laptop processor or graphics behavior without assuming the chips can be replaced.

steps.title: Record crashes, display faults, or slowdowns
Check temperatures, fan behavior, and Device Manager
Test the internal and external display when relevant
Run a monitored test only when temperatures are safe
Record readings and whether the issue points to cooling, software, or hardware

repair.description: We’ll correct serviceable cooling or driver causes of processor and graphics problems.

steps.title: Confirm whether cooling or software is the likely cause
Perform approved cooling work if indicated
Correct affected drivers if indicated
Document chip or mainboard faults needing specialist work
Record the repeat test and remaining symptoms

diagnostic.description: We’ll check laptop storage detection, health, and file access.

steps.title: Record the drive model and reported symptoms
Check detection and removable-drive connections
Review available drive-health information
Avoid extended tests on a drive showing signs of failure
Record results and any urgent backup recommendation

repair.description: We’ll correct storage connections, approved boot faults, or replace a failed drive.

steps.title: Confirm backup instructions before changing storage
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work
Reseat the drive or replace it if confirmed faulty
Perform approved boot repair or data restoration
Record boot and file-access results

upgrade.description: We’ll install compatible storage using the approved migration plan.

steps.title: Confirm drive size, interface, and laptop support
Confirm backup, cloning, or reinstall instructions
Install the drive and complete the approved migration
Record capacity, health, boot, and file-access results

diagnostic.description: We’ll identify laptop Windows startup, driver, update, or software problems.

steps.title: Record symptoms and recent changes
Check startup, Device Manager, and relevant error records
Check storage health before extensive repair attempts
Use recovery media when needed without changing data
Record the likely cause and recommended next step

repair.description: We’ll perform approved Windows and driver repairs.

steps.title: Confirm backup instructions and recovery-key access
Repair the identified startup, file, software, or driver fault
Install approved updates and required laptop drivers
Record startup, activation, and affected-device results

upgrade.description: We’ll move the laptop to an approved, supported Windows installation.

steps.title: Confirm hardware support, license, backup, and approval
Verify recovery-key access before changing encrypted storage
Perform the approved upgrade or reinstall
Install required laptop drivers, updates, and approved software
Record activation, file access, startup, and device tests

repair.description: We’ll reinstall or reimage Windows when repair is not practical.

steps.title: Confirm customer approval, license, and that data loss is understood
Back up or clone the drive (for example with Clonezilla) and verify the image (if requested)
Verify recovery-key access before changing encrypted storage
Choose and record the method: reset, clean reinstall, or restore image
Install laptop drivers, updates, and approved software
Restore approved data and record activation, startup, and device results

maintenance.description: We’ll tune Windows settings such as the page file and startup load.

steps.title: Record installed RAM, free disk space, and memory-related symptoms
Check page file (virtual memory) size and location; restore system-managed sizing if altered
Review startup programs, pending updates, and disk cleanup needs
Record settings changed and before-and-after behavior

diagnostic.description: We’ll assess liquid or contamination damage and which components may survive.

steps.title: Record the liquid type, when it happened, and what was done since
Keep the laptop off, unplugged, and disconnect the internal battery
Photograph residue, corrosion, and affected areas
Inspect mainboard, keyboard, ports, battery, and display cable for contamination
Annotate what is cleanable, needs replacement, or if the system is unrecoverable

steps.title: Confirm approved scope and that success is not guaranteed
Disconnect the internal battery, remove parts, clean each, and dry fully

steps.title: Record the primary fault and how it was confirmed
Test charger, battery, storage, RAM, display, and ports for related damage
Record each component as damaged, good, or untested
Quote the full scope and explain the effect on cost to the customer

diagnostic.description: We’ll assess cracks, bent connectors, and other physical damage.

steps.title: Photograph the damage, including bent or broken connectors and pins
Record whether the damaged part is repairable or must be replaced

repair.description: We’ll repair or replace physically damaged parts with customer approval.

Test startup and the affected components

diagnostic.description: We’ll check the laptop fan and heat sink for cooling faults.

repair.description: We’ll clean or replace serviceable laptop cooling parts.

diagnostic.description: We’ll identify whether a screen, cable, setting, or graphics fault affects the display.

steps.title: Record flickering, lines, backlight, or image problems
Test an external display when available
Check whether gently moving the lid changes the image

Record which display outputs work

steps.title: Confirm the exact screen, cable, or assembly needed
Disconnect the internal battery before display work

Record image, brightness, camera, and lid-movement tests

upgrade.description: We’ll install a better screen only when the laptop supports it.

steps.title: Confirm panel, cable, mounting, resolution, and refresh compatibility
Disconnect the internal battery before installation
Install the approved compatible panel
Record brightness, resolution, refresh rate, and lid tests

diagnostic.description: We’ll check keyboard keys, backlight, touchpad, and input connections.

steps.title: Test affected keys, function keys, and backlight
Test touchpad movement, clicks, scrolling, and gestures
Check for liquid damage or battery swelling

steps.title: Confirm replacement layout and model compatibility
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work

Check visible damage, settings, and driver errors

upgrade.description: We’ll install supported wireless hardware or an external adapter.

Install the approved internal or external hardware

Record Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and connection tests

diagnostic.description: We’ll check hinges, covers, mounting points, and cables near the lid.

steps.title: Photograph cracks, gaps, and missing hardware
Gently check lid movement without forcing damaged hinges
Check for display changes or cable damage during movement
Record affected parts and whether use could worsen damage

repair.description: We’ll replace approved damaged hinges, covers, brackets, or mounting parts.

steps.title: Confirm the exact replacement assembly and customer approval
Disconnect the internal battery before internal work
Replace damaged parts and route display and antenna cables safely
Record lid alignment, display, camera, and wireless tests

diagnostic.description: We’ll check laptop startup firmware and whether an update is needed.

steps.title: Record the exact laptop model and current firmware version
Check the symptom or compatibility reason for an update
Review relevant boot and device-detection settings
Record whether an update is recommended and why

update.description: We’ll install approved laptop firmware for a specific need.

steps.title: Confirm the exact model and manufacturer-approved firmware
Record the existing version and important firmware settings
Verify backup instructions and recovery-key access if encrypted
Check battery condition and connect a reliable compatible charger
Follow the manufacturer's update method without interruption

diagnostic.description: We’ll investigate heat, loud fans, slowdowns, or heat-related shutdowns.

steps.title: Record when heat or shutdowns occur
Check idle temperatures, fan response, and available vents

steps.title: Disconnect power and the internal battery before internal cleaning
